intent: Filter chip for lists and tables: shows the filter name or its chosen value, opens its options, and turns an applied filter on or off.
useWhen: Filters above a table or list, like Status, Owner, or Date
A filter the user can keep but switch off for a moment, without losing what they picked
doNotUseWhen: Page actions or view switches — use Button or DropdownMenu
Status or category labels that are not filters — use Badge
A number without a filter name — use Count

size.note: Heights space-8 / space-10 / space-12. The chevron part is square.

open.note: Options are open. Sets aria-expanded and turns the chevron.

count.note: Applied values, like 3 statuses. Above 0 the filter is set and shows a kit Count.

value.note: The chosen value. Shows as Status: Pending, the name quieter than the value.

toggle.note: On or off once a filter is set. Leave it out and a set filter is on. Off keeps the selection but does not apply it: dashed outline, muted count.

onToggle.note: () => void. With a filter set, the name part becomes its own button that turns it on or off, and only the chevron opens the options.

hasDropdown.note: false: a plain on/off chip with no chevron, for filters with no value to pick. Clicking it calls onToggle.

onClick.note: Opens the options: the whole button when nothing is set, or the chevron once it splits.

requirements: Nothing set: one native button with aria-haspopup=menu and aria-expanded
Split: the name is a toggle button with aria-pressed; the chevron is a separate button named {children} options, with aria-haspopup and aria-expanded
Its name is the filter name or Name: value, plus the count, like Status, 3 filters applied
Each button has its own focus ring

doNot: Do not invent a local split button, filter chip, or dropdown trigger
Do not use for page actions or view switches — use Button or DropdownMenu
Do not put more than one word or two in the name
Do not show the count as text in the label — pass count and compose kit Count
Do not invent FilterChip, SplitButton, or FilterTrigger
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
